Definition: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
BiblicalUsage: n f; 1) daughter; 1a) daughter, girl, adopted daughter, daughter-in-law, sister, granddaughters, female child, cousin; 1a1) as polite address; n pr f; 1a2) as designation of women of a particular place; 2) young women, women; 1a3) as personification; 1a4) daughter-villages; 1a5) description of character
